## Checklist
- [ ] `cargo fmt --all` is clean
- [ ] `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` passes

- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated under the relevant version (or `[Unreleased]`)

- [ ] No breaking CLI / public API change (or explicitly approved)
